title: AscensionReading
description: Spiritual ascension as a digital-spiritual analogue of the reputation model. An AscensionReading is the holder's reputation-model STATE abstracted into the spine's inner vocabulary: each ReputationDimension value (from the holder's SacredCapitalLedger) is projected through that dimension's latticeBinding onto a gate's inner axis. The set of those projections IS 'ascension' — not a separate computation, but the same earned state re-represented through the correspondence lattice. The abstraction is computed on the holder's own device/agent and is never a network service: no party but the holder may render or store the holder's inner state. Direction is strictly one-way (reputation state -> inner axes); identity inputs never flow into reputation; the inner rendering reaches the outside world only when the holder deliberately mints a PortableReputationClaim. Each projection is deterministic and replayable, optionally bound to a ReasoningReplayPlan.

id.description: Stable URN identifier for this reading.

specVersion.description: Semantic version of the contract this document conforms to.

capturedAt.description: Timestamp when the reading was rendered.

subjectRef.description: Pseudonymous, agent-centric reference to the holder. Must match the soul and the capital being abstracted.

abstractionOf.description: Ascension is an abstraction of the reputation model state into the spiritual analogue. Always 'reputation-model-state'.

computedOn.description: Where the abstraction ran. Must be a holder-controlled context.

networkServiceProhibited.description: Normative guard: this rendering may never be performed as a hosted/network service. Always true.

inputs.description: The reputation-model state being abstracted. Evidence flows transitively through the SacredCapitalLedger entries' own evidenceRefs (works-receipts on the reasoning-evidence fabric).

sacredCapitalRef.description: The holder's SacredCapitalLedger whose entries are abstracted.

dimensionRefs.description: The reputation dimensions being abstracted. Each MUST carry a latticeBinding; unbound dimensions cannot be rendered into the spine.

projections.description: Deterministic projection of each bound dimension value onto a gate inner axis, via the dimension's latticeBinding. This list is the rendered ascension state.

deterministic.description: The projection is a pure function of the dimension value, its latticeBinding, and the spine; replayable. Always true.

replayPlanRef.description: Optional binding to a ReasoningReplayPlan so the abstraction is replayable like any reasoning run.

result.description: Net rendered movement per axis. Private; never auto-emitted.

directionality.description: The normative direction constraints, encoded so conformance can be machine-checked.

reputationStateToInnerAxes.description: Reputation state may be abstracted onto inner axes. Always 'allowed'.

identityInputsToReputation.description: Identity inputs may never flow into reputation. Always 'forbidden'.

innerToOutsideRequiresClaim.description: Inner state reaches the outside only via a holder-minted PortableReputationClaim. Always true.

privacyClass.description: The reading and its result are private to the holder.
